tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: zab bdun mchog zab yang dag gi: sgrub pa man ngag gcig dril bzhugs:

ྈྈྈ bla med he ru ka la 'dud: kun gyi mthar thug yang dag gi: sgrub thabs rtsa ba bshad par bya: bya ba phrugs btang lha bsgom brtsam: bum tsaka thod sku mar me sogs: gsang ba'i rten mchog steng na bsags: yang na spros med ting 'dzin bsgom: sngon du 'gro ba'i rim pa ni: dang po dben par dkyil 'khor bsham: sgrub rten gsang ba'i tshogs mchod bcas: rgyud sbyangs yan lag bdun pa bya: rang nyid zhe sdang rdo rjer bsgom: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ bi shwa badzra kro dha dzwa la maṇḍa la phaṭa phaṭa ha la ha la hūm̐: hūm̐: yang dag lta ba'i ngang nyid las: khro bo'i sprin kun 'phros pa yis: bgegs dang log 'dren tshar bcad nas: tshur 'dus rdo rje'i gur khang che: me rlung chu yi rim pas bskor: sus kyang gzhom du med par bsam: badzra raṃ yaṃ khaṃ rakṣa: bshags yul spyan drangs dpang gsol te: hūm̐: ye nas gnyis med chos skur dag pa la: ma rig dbang gis sgro dang skur btab ste: bde dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs ngo bor smin: de ldog don phyir rgyal ba'i dam mnos te: bdag cag ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyi: bag med tshul gyis dam las 'gal gyur te: rgyal ba 'khor bcas thugs dang ci 'gal ba: thugs rje che mnga' khyed la bzod par gsol: dam bca' brtan por bzung nas su: oṃ: kun tu bzang po bla na med pa yi: byang chub mchog tu bdag ni sems bskyed de: don dam dang ni kun rdzob byang chub sems: bla ma lha khyod rtag tu gzung bar bgyi: rgyas par brjod med bshags pa dang: dam bca' nyi shu la sogs bya: mos gus gdung bas byin chen 'beb: oṃ āḥhūm̐ a la la ho: bha ga wān sa ma ya ho: sa ma ya st+waṃ: 'phags mchog thugs rje'i dus la bab: khyad par bstan pa'i dus la bab: mthu rtsal phyung ba'i dus la bab: byin gyis brlab pa'i dus la bab: dbang mchog bskur ba'i dus la bab: dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la bab: mthu chen bdud 'dul bcom ldan 'das:

byin chen byin phob bcom ldan 'das: dbang chen dbang skur bcom ldan 'das: dngos grub mchog stsol bcom ldan 'das: bdag cag las 'bras mchis par mdzod: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: byin bsdus phyi nang mchod pa rnams: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis bsregs gtor bkrus: bdud rtsi'i snod ni gzhal yas khang: 'khor lo rtsibs bzhir dam rdzas bcu: sa bon phyag mtshan rigs lnga'i tshul: yab yum mnyam sbyor bdud rtsir zhu: bhandha bdud rtsi oṃ gyis mtshan: rgya gram rta mgrin yum bzhi mnan: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: sbyor ba'i 'od kyis bdud rtsi bsdus: 'od zhu bdud rtsir dbyer med 'dres: gtor gzhong bhandha'i nang du ni: gtor ma oṃ las 'dod yon 'phro: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ba liṃ ta te dzo ba liṃ ta ba la ba te gu hya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: padma bhañdza'i snod nang du: ra las rakta'i rgya mtsho 'khyil: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rakta dzwa la maṇḍal hūm̐ hrī ṭhā: mchod snod zhing khams phun tshogs pa: mchod pa lha mo'i rol par bsam: na maḥs manta buddhā nāṃ ga ga na khaṃ sa ma ye swā hā: oṃ shrī badzra rā ga dhū pe dhū: oṃ shrī badzra rā ga puṣpe pu: oṃ shrī badzra rā ga ā lo ke hrī: oṃ shrī badzra rā ga gandhe gan: dngos gzhi ting 'dzin mchog bsgom ste: hūm̐: chos rnams rnam dag mtha' bzhi bral: rang bzhin ye shes kun la khyab: rang rig thugs rje'i hūm̐ sngon po: mkha' la nyi ma bzhin du shar: rdo rje hūm̐ las 'phros 'dus thim: rgyu yi he ru ka dpal ni: mthing nag rdo rje dril bu 'dzin: cho 'phrul e yaṃ ra suṃ keṃ: raṃ bhrūm̐ 'phros pas nam mkha' rlung: khrag mtsho zhing gi sa gzhi la: keng rus ri rab me chen 'bar: rdo rje me ri rab 'bar ba: dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus: thod pa rin chen gzhal yas khang: gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs brgyad: zhing gi thog phub ru tra'i mgo:

tsitta 'od 'bar tog gis mdzes: gru chad zla gam dgu dang ldan: brag chen padma nyi zla'i gdan: ru tra pho mo'i zhing gi steng: rgyu yi khrag 'thung dbus su 'khod: khro mo dbyings phyug mngon phyung nas: mnyam sbyor bde ba chen por zhu: bde ba'i ro yis don gnyis byas: he he dgyes bskul hūm̐ hūm̐ gyur: rdo rje 'bar ba'i 'phro 'du mdzad: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐: bdag nyid yang dag he ru ka: mthing nag dkar dmar sngo ba'i mdangs: rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ rnge'u chung g.yas: dril bu bhan dmar rgyu zhags g.yon: gar dgu'i nyams ldan zhabs bzhi rol: dpal dang dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: kro dhī shwa rī nam mkha'i mdangs: kha ṭwāṃ dung dmar 'dzin pa 'khril: 'bar ba'i phreng ba rab tu 'khrugs: spyi bor rigs lnga yab yum sbyor: chu yis sgrib sbyangs dbang bskur nas: yab yum rigs lngas dbu yang brgyan: oṃ ma hā shūn+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā ba ātma ko3 haṃ: ā darsha= sa ma tā= pra ti bekṣa ṇa= kṛ tyānuṣṭha na= gnas lngar zla ba pad nyi dang: nyi ma rin chen rgya gram la: oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā rnams las: 'od 'phros rgyal ba thams cad mchod: ye shes lnga rnams bsdus nas thim: rigs lnga yab yum sku ru gyur: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badzra swa bhā ba ātma ko3 haṃ: wā ka= tsitta= a nu rā ga ṇa= pū dza= yab gsang hūm̐ las rdo rje'i dbus: oṃ dkar bu ga phaṭa kyis bkag: yum mkha' paṃ las padma'i sbubs: aṃ dmar ge sar es mtshan gyur: sa ma ya st+waṃ: sa ma ya ho: a nu rā ga haṃ: a nu rā ga yā mi: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: sbyor ba'i byang chub sems sprin gyis: rgyal ba kun bkug bde bas zhu: sku yi dbyibs brgyud gsang bar babs: yum gyi mkha' la lan gsum spros: yan lag bzhi yi tshul du rdzogs: rten dang sa bon bcas par gyur: hūm̐ ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha: oṃ badzra shrī he ru ka hūm̐: badzra kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐:

oṃ badzra gau rī ha: oṃ badzra tsau rī ha: oṃ badzra pra mo ha ha: oṃ badzra be tā li ha: oṃ badzra pukka si ha: oṃ badzra ghasma rī ha: oṃ badzra sme sha ni ha: oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa lī ha: phyogs mtshams brgyad kyi zla gam la: gau rī chos nyid mi 'gyur sngo: ye shes dbyings su sgrol ba'i dbyug: tsau rī ye shes rgyas pas ser: thugs rje bskul phyir mda' gzhu 'geng: pra mo thugs rjes chags pas dmar: nyon mongs rgyu mkhyen chu srin 'dzin: be tā chos nyid mi 'gyur nag: sa dgur spor ba'i rdo rje 'dzin: pukka ma 'gag dmar ser 'bar: 'khor ba'i rgyun gcod byis rgyu 'dren: ghasma las bzhi thogs med ljang: nyon mongs dbyings sgrol thod khrag dkrug: sme sha thabs shes mi 'gyur mthing: nyon stong khams sku'i bam snying gsol: tsaṇḍa lhun grub skyon bral ser: mtha' gnyis zhing gi mgo lus phral: ye shes dgu yi dkyil 'khor rnams: ngo bo gcig la rnam rol tshul: ma bcos ngang nas rang gsal btab: ye shes rdo rje rtse lngas mtshan: ngo bo ro gcig ma 'dres pa: dkyil 'khor bsam yas lhun grub gyur: rang rig hūm̐ sngon rtag 'char bas: 'od kyis chos dbyings kun khyab nas: chos sku gzugs kyi sku ru bzhengs: oṃ: phyogs dus dkyil 'khor bdag nyid che: dmigs med thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor las: dkyil 'khor thams cad spyan drang ngo: rang snang dbyer med dkyil 'khor du: 'jug pa'i mtshan nyid mnyam sbyor bas: phyogs dus kun nas gshegs pa yi: bsnyen pa'i dkyil 'khor rab tu rdzogs: nye bar gyur pa'i dam tshig mchog: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐: e hye hi ā na ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: nye bar drangs nas dbyer med rig: oṃ badzra kro dha sa ma ya hūm̐: oṃ badzra kro dha sa ma ya st+waṃ: oṃ badzra kro dha sa ma ya phaṭa: oṃ badzra kro dha sa ma ya ho: bstims nas brtan bskul dbang du bya: hūm̐ ha he phaṭa: gsal byas phyag mchod bstod 'bul ni:

tiṣṭha badzra: a ti pū ho: pra tītstsha ho: oṃ hūm̐: bde bar gshegs pa bcom ldan 'das: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i ye shes kyis: srid pa rgya mtsho mtha' yas kun: kun bzang mchod sprin mchog tu rol: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā: 'byung ba chen po nam mkha' che: 'byung ba chen po lnga yi mdzod: nam mkha' las ni 'dod pa 'byung: 'dod pa'i mchod pa 'byung gyur cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ su ra to ma hā rā ga pa na peṃ: pe nu su ra to: ti pu pa ra mu: sarba ta thā ga ta siddhi hu: sa ma yo ta mu: sarba ma hā su kha siddhi hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: yang dag don du dag mod kyang: 'gro ba yongs kyi don slad du: phyag dang zhabs ni bsil nas kyang: rdo rje'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol: oṃ ā ha ra ā ha ra sarba bidyā dhā ra pū dzi te na maḥs manta buddha nāṃ ga ga na khaṃ sa ma ye swā hā: oṃ hūm̐: spos kyi sprin lding bdug pa mo: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gdugs kyis 'gebs: byams pa thabs dang shes rab las: badzra dhū pe'i mchod par rol: oṃ shrī badzra rā ga dhū pe dhū: utpal mthing ga me tog 'thor: sna tshogs rin chen 'od du 'phro: snying rje thabs dang shes rab las: badzra puṣpe'i mchod par rol: oṃ shrī badzra rā ga puṣpe pu: dbang gi phyag na sgron me bsnams: chos kyi rgyal po 'bar ba 'dzin: dga' ba thabs dang shes rab las: badzra ā lo ke'i mchod par rol: oṃ shrī badzra rā ga ā lo ke hrī: tsandan bdud rtsi'i char 'beb ma: dkyil 'khor gsal ba'i thig le 'beb: btang snyoms thabs dang shes rab las: badzra gandhe'i mchod par rol: oṃ shrī badzra rā ga gandhe gan: hūm̐: rang byung gdod nas rnam dag pa'i: bdud rtsi rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar: dug lnga sel ba'i sman gyi mchog: rmad byung mchod pa bzhes su gsol: ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi:

kā ya bā ka tsitta siddhi oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: khams gsum chags pa'i 'dzin pa bsgral: chags med chags bral dmar chen po: dug gsum rnam par sbyang ba'i phyir: dkyil 'khor lha rnams bzhes su gsol: ma hā rakta pra tītstsha khā hi: hūm̐: 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga ldan pa: ye shes lnga yi mchod sprin che: dam rdzas gtor ma'i mchod sprin 'di: mchod do bzhes shig dgyes par rol: ma hā ba liṃ ta pra tītstsha kha raṃ khā hi: hūm̐: thabs shes mnyam sbyor bde chen sprin: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kun mchod de: 'khor ba'i 'khrul rtog thams cad bsgral: mnyam nyid spros bral ye mchod 'bul: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badzra swā bhā ba ātma ko3 haṃ: bo dhi tsitta spha ra ṇa phaṭa: dharma dhā tu shuddhe a: hūm̐: gtum chen dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar: 'od zer nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi: khro gnyer glog stong 'gyu ba bzhin: mche ba zang yag za byed che hoḥ hūm̐: rngam pa'i nga ro 'brug stong ldir: gtum chen ri rab 'bum bsnyil skad: a la la yi gad rgyangs che: spyugs pa'i 'thor rlung g.yeng ba che ho: hūm̐: khro bo shes rab 'od po che: ye shes dkyil 'khor kun tu gsal: 'bar ba'i ye shes kun tu 'joms: sna tshogs ye shes thig le che ho: hūm̐: khro bo'i rgyal po sprin chen po: 'phros pa'i dkyil 'khor char chen 'beb: dkyil 'khor ye bzhin 'byung ba'i gter: sna tshogs khros pa'i thig le che ho: hūm̐: bdud kun gyi ni bdud chen po: bdud kyi bdud de bdud rnams 'joms: 'jigs pa'i tshogs rnams 'jigs byed pa: 'jigs byed chen po'i thig le che ho: hūm̐: rdo rje brag chen sra ba po: rdo rje chu ste sdud chen po: rdo rje me ste kun 'bar che: rdo rje rlung ste 'thor rlung che ho: spro na mchod pa bcu drug 'bul: bshags shing dam bca' dngos grub bcol: de nas dzap kyi rim pa ni: bsnyen pa thugs zla zur brgyad steng:

shin tu phra ba'i gzugs kyis ni: sems dpa' rdor dril 'dzin dkar po: nyi ma la gnas rdo rje hūm̐: 'bru brgyad las ni ba thag gzing: rgyal ba kun bskul dngos grub bsdus: hūm̐ la thim pas sdig sgrib sbyangs: nye bar snying brgyad hūm̐ mthing 'bar: smra byed 'dab brgyad āḥdang ldan: tshangs pa 'khor lo oṃ ldan pas: mthing dmar dkar ba'i phra brgyad ldan: thugs ljags nyi ma spyi bor brgyud: zla bar phyungs nas rgyal ba yi: gsang ba bskul zhing bsnyen pa'i las: bsdus nas bzhi gsum la ni bstim: bsgrub phyir sems dpa' sum brtsegs pa: dbu ljags rnam snang mtha' yas sku: nyi steng oṃ āḥ'abru brgyad kyi: sngags sgras thugs kyi 'khor lo bskul: tshangs gnas 'og min 'brel ba yi: rgyal po btsun mo'i bcud drangs nas: bdag nyid byang chub sems dang ldan: chen po phrin las 'od dkar gyi: tshangs pa'i dbyangs ni zhi ba dang: dmar ser 'brug sgra dbang byed rgyas: mthing nag 'bar ba'i tshwa tshwa 'phro: rdo rje srin po'i ngur sgra'i gdangs: khyad par mnan pa'i las la bsngags: dmar nag khur ba dbugs 'byin gyis: bzlog dang phrin las rgya mtsho 'grub: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐: yang na so so'i sngags bzlas nas: bstod pa'i rim pa rgyud bzhin bya: de tshe rtags kyi rim pa yang: grub rtags dbang gi rgyud bzhin 'grub: rjes kyi bya ba tshogs mchod ni: ma da na dang māṃ sa sogs: bdud rtsi 'dod yon bsang chus sbyang: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis bsregs gtor bkrus: rnam par rtog pa dmigs med dbyings: ma las nyi ma'i snod yangs par: hūm̐ oṃ swā āḥhā rnams las: ye shes lnga yi 'dod yon sprin: bla na med pa'i tshogs su gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: he ru ka yi gnas bcu dang: dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas: dpal chen khrag 'thung spyan 'dren gyis: dur khrod mchog gi gnas 'di ru: zhing chen gsar rnying ri ltar spungs:

dmar gyi arghaṃ rgya mtshor bskyil: ma lus bzhes shing bsnams su gsol: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ e hye hi ā na ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: mchod pa'i rim pa ci yang spro: hūm̐: bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa ni: ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro: 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yi tshogs mchod 'di: thugs dam bzhin du ci bder bzhes su gsol: oṃ ga ṇa tsakra pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa pra tītstsha ho: hūm̐: tshe rabs thog ma med pa tshun chad nas: da lta'i lus 'di blangs pa yan chad du: lus kyis sdig byas spyod pa ngan du spyad: ngag gis tshig rtsub 'khyal smra ngan du brjod: sems kyis blo nor log par sems pa dang: 'dod khro gti mug dbang gis nongs bgyis pa: bkram pa'i lha tshogs rnams la bzod par gsol: ye shes lha la rtog pa mi mnga' yang: de yi 'khor du gtogs pa'i lha srin rnams: mi yi skyon mthong tsam nas bar chad rtsom: nongs shing 'gal 'khrul ci bgyis mthol lo bshags: yig brgya brjod la gzugs byang la: bden stobs brjod la dmigs bya bkug: e yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du: 'bar ba gtum chen rngams pa rnams: khros pa'i yid kyis bskul byas na: sangs rgyas bsod nams sku yang 'jig: bdud rtsi lnga dang zas lnga la: mtshan ma ming dang bcas pa la: bkug ste rdo rje phur pas bsgral: rdul du brlags nas tshogs su 'bul: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐: sarba duṣṭān mā ra ya hūm̐:

log 'dren bdud rtsir spar nas 'bul: hūm̐: rdo rje 'bar ba'i tshogs mchod 'di: mchod sprin kun tu rgyas gyur cig: dug gsum brtsegs pa'i ri bo 'di: sku gsung thugs kyi klong du stob: ma hā māṃ sa rakta kiṃ ni ri ti kha raṃ khā hi: brda' dang brda yi 'bul len gyis: longs spyod nang gi sbyin sreg bya: glu gar srog ldan 'chad nyan dang: dbang bskur sbyor bas nyams rtogs 'phel: lhag ma gsog 'jog med par bsdus: zhing la khrag gis maṇḍal bri: phud lhag mar me sman raka bsham: rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gsal btab la: a bhrūm̐ hūm̐ ha he phaṭa: lhag ma'i dkyil 'khor gsal bar bsgom: zla ba la gnas gtor ma ni: oṃ las 'dod yon 'phro bar bsam: oṃ āḥhūm̐: 'dod rgyal phyag rgya sdud pa'i sgras: e ā ralli hring hring: oṃ ḍā ki ā karṣa ya: ā karṣa ya: pra be sha ya: pra be sha ya: bhandha ya: bhandha ya: to ṣā ya: to ṣā ya: mo ha ya: mo ha ya: badzra ḍā ki nī nāṃ: hṛ da ya hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ ḍā ki nī hūm̐ phaṭa: 'dod pa'i las rnams byed par bsam: rta gdong snyems pas phyag rgya bya: hrīḥpadma ba ḍa ba mu khā: a karṣa ya: a karṣa ya: pra be sha ya: pra be sha ya: bhandha ya: bhandha ya: to ṣā ya: to ṣā ya: mo ha ya: mo ha ya: badzra ḍā ki nī nāṃ: hṛ da ya hūm̐ phaṭa: ha ha hi hi: dbang du 'dus shing bka' sdod bsam: mgron rnams rigs lnga'i tshom bu ru: bzhugs shing gtor ma len par bsam: he ru ka yi thod rgya bya: oṃ badzra ḍā ki nī pra tītstshe maṃ ba liṃ ta hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ buddha ḍā ki nī pra tītstshe maṃ ba liṃ ta oṃ phaṭa: ratna ḍā ki nī pra tītstshe maṃ ba liṃ ta trāṃ phaṭa: padma ḍā ki nī pra tītstshe maṃ ba liṃ ta hrīḥphaṭa: karma ḍā ki nī pra tītstshe maṃ ba liṃ ta āḥphaṭa: gtor ma phud bcas rme bar blugs: lce ni rta mgrin yab yum gnyis: sbyar ba'i byang sems dza gad kyi: kha phru dam rgyas 'beb par bya:

oṃ gu ru kro dha ratna sa ma ya pri sha sarba buddha kṣe ṭa pā la kṣo bha kā ra hūm̐ phaṭa: sman dang rakta gtor mas mchod: hūm̐: dang po phud kyis mi mchod rgyu: bcom ldan dpal chen phud kyi bdag: bar du tshogs kyis mi mchod rgyu: ma mo mkha' 'gro tshogs kyi bdag: tha ma lhag mas mi mchod rgyu: ma tshogs dbang phyug lhag ma'i gnas: lhag ma kha chus mi gdab rgyu: bran pho bran mo kha chu'i bdag: rnam gsum rim gyis mi mchod rgyu: bka' dang gzhung lugs rim par yod: rnam gsum gcig tu mi bsre rgyu: chos kyi dbyings su tha mi dad: las rnams so sor mi bcol rgyu: las kyi 'dul skal rim par yod: nam mkha' stong la dbang bsgyur ba'i: mkha' 'gro sum cu rtsa gnyis dang: stong khams yongs la mnga' mdzad pa'i: dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang: srog dbugs kun la mnga' mdzad pa: skyes bu ging chen bco brgyad dang: rdo rje phra men rdzu 'phrul can: skyes bu lang ka drug cu dang: ta kṛta lcam du zhal bzhes pa'i: 'bar ma nyu le brgyad rnams dang: sha khrag zhal du gsol mdzad pa: dur khrod dregs pa'i ma mo bdun: rgyal chen sring mor zhal bzhes pa'i: sring mo chen mo bzhi rnams dang: phyogs bcur khyab par las byed pa'i: pho nya sum brgya drug cu dang: ri rab rming nas 'degs mdzad pa'i: dbang gi gru 'degs bzhi rnams dang: pha rol dmag dpung 'joms mdzad pa'i: dmag gi rgyal mo chen mo bzhi: dpal gyi bka' sdod khyed rnams kyis: dam rdzas sha khrag gtor ma longs: rnam lnga'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ho: lhag ma'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: phud dang gtor ma bzhes su gsol: dam tshig nyams chag skong bar mdzod: dngos grub ma lus bstsal du gsol: phrin las rgya mtsho 'grub par mdzod: ya hi gatstsha sa rang gnas gshegs: gtor ma mu ran bar du bskyal: hūm̐: lhag dkyil rang gi snying gar bsdu: srung ma'i gtor ma byin gyis brlab:

raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: bhrūm̐ āoṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: sngon tshe gsang ba'i gnas mchog tu: rgyal ba sems dpa' rnal 'byor ma'i: spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas pa'i: bka' yi srung ma 'khor dang bcas: dam rdzas gtor ma 'di longs la: zhal bzhes dam bca' de bzhin du: sgrub pa'i sdongs grogs phrin las mdzod: brtan ma'i gtor ma byin gyis brlab: trāṃ ratna trai lokya phaṭa: gtor ma'i rdul phran re re bzhin: rin chen gur khyim longs spyod gyur: 'bru gsum dag gis byin gyis brlab: hūm̐: tshogs dang bka' yi tshogs bcas nyid: khrag 'thung de bzhin nam mkha'i sku: tshur gshegs tshur gshegs skyong ma rnams: 'dir byon dam skong dngos grub stsol: brtan ma skyong mdzad ma dang sring: dpal gnas ma dang yang dag shes: khyung btsun kong lha g.yu bun ma: me tog zla 'od byang rgyal ma: gser thang kun bzang shāntiṃ dpal: klu mo gzi 'bar la sogs pa'i: brtan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas: a su ra yi brag phug tu: slob dpon padma 'byung gnas dang: rlangs chen dpal gyi seng ge yi: spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: dam chu bka' yi gtor ma longs: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ la lā le le taṃ taṃ te te kha rakma: ma ma sriṃ 'gro ma hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐ hūm̐: ma hā pañtsa a mṛta rakta ba liṃ ta khā hi: srung ma gatstsha sa gshegs par bya: gtor gzhong sbubs la bro yang brdung: yā yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du: ye shes zhi ba chen po rnams: thugs rje chen pos bro brdungs pas: gti mug rdo rje 'khor bcas kyis: 'jig rten khams ni rab 'byams kun: nyon mongs bdud dang mi mthun tshogs: yud tsam gyis ni zhi mdzad pa'i: zhi ba'i las rnams 'grub par mdzod: mā yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du: ngo mtshar brjid pa chen po rnams: rngams pa'i yid kyis bro brdungs pas: nga rgyal rdo rje 'khor bcas kyis: 'jig rten khams ni rab 'byams kun:

dpal dang gzi brjid chen po rnams: yud tsam gyis ni rgyas par mdzod: rgyas pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: waṃ gyi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du: bde ba chen po'i gar bsgyur rnams: chags pa'i yid kyis bro brdungs pas: 'dod chags rdo rje 'khor bcas kyis: 'jig rten khams ni rab 'byams kun: rgyal blon pho mo 'bru nor rnams: yud tsam gyis ni dbang du sdus: dbang gi phrin las 'grub par mdzod: e yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du: 'bar ba gtum chen rngams pa rnams: khros pa'i yid kyis bro brdungs pas: zhe sdang rdo rje 'khor bcas kyis: 'jig rten khams ni rab 'byams kun: ru tra dgra bgegs ma lus pa: yud tsam gyis ni brlag par mdzod: drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: gtang rag mchod bstod nongs pa bshags: hūm̐: sems can don phyir nan tan mchog bskyed de: ye shes thugs rjes bdag la dgongs nas kyang: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub dam pa rnams: bdag la bstsal zhing brtan par bzhugs su gsol: kā ya bā ka tsitta tiṣṭha badzra: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: snang srid dkyil 'khor 'od du zhu: bdag la 'dus shing bdag nyid kyang: hūm̐ la 'dus shing mi dmigs gyur: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: slar yang bdag nyid he ru ka: gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan: badzra kā bā tsi rakṣa haṃ: spyi bo'i haṃ zhu rdo rje'i go: mdzub mo oṃ hūm̐ khro bo gnyis: lte ba snying ga ltag pa dang: dpral ba spyi bo gnas lnga ru: khro bo lu gu rgyud du gyur: hūm̐ hūm̐: oṃ badzra ka pā la a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ trāṃ: dbu rgyan bkon la cod pan yang: oṃ ārya laṃ bho dha ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥhrīḥ mthing dmar 'phyang zhing 'phur bar bsam: yi ge brgya pas brtan par bya: shis par bya zhing dge ba bsngo: rtag tu ting 'dzin mi 'bral bar: snang srid dag pa chen po ru: 'gro ba'i don la spyod par bya: thabs des rig 'dzin bzhi gang rung: 'grub nas bla med sa mchog thob:
de phyir rtse gcig nyams len bya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya:
